data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's core claim that the ritual's independence assumption fails cannot be adjudicated as a valid fault because the target itself states it has no commitments (schemas or claims) to evaluate against the problem context. Without any machine-evaluated commitments (which are noted as passing) or additional defined claims to cross-reference against the adjudication standard (§11.3), there is no available surface to sustain or refute the target's assertion. The critic cannot mechanically or logically validate the target's 'false negative' claim without a specific target commitment to test, rendering the audit incomplete by lack of defined scope rather than a proven fault.
